in_english.name: Jaleelah
in_english.meaning: Jaleelah noble, elevated, refined, beautiful, and charming
in_english.long_meaning: Jaleelah is an Arabic name that means noble, elevated, refined, beautiful, and charming. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'jal' which means high or elevated. In Islamic tradition, the name Jaleelah is associated with the qualities of nobility, refinement, and beauty. It is a name that is highly valued in many Muslim cultures and is often given to girls born into families of high social status. The name Jaleelah is also associated with the concept of ' Jamal' in Islamic theology, which refers to the beauty and perfection of God. In modern times, the name Jaleelah has become popular in many parts of the world, including the Middle East, South Asia, and North Africa. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Islamic culture and tradition, and is often considered a symbol of nobility, refinement, and beauty.
